definition: Unification of mind governed by the signless side of the emptiness / signless / wishless family.
notes: Keep this compound tied to animitta's signless force rather than turning it into vague imageless or blank meditation language.
version_notes: Revised 2026-11-08 by explicit editorial decision to follow Dhammarato's spoken usage in the 2014–2026 talk transcripts: follows the samādhi headword.

example_phrases.pali: bhikkhu sabbanimittānaṁ amanasikārā animittaṁ cetosamādhiṁ upasampajja viharati
example_phrases.translation: by not attending to any signs, a bhikkhu enters and remains in the signless unification of mind
example_phrases.notes: MN 43 defines the signless release of mind by this attainment.

example_phrases.pali: animittaṁ cetosamādhiṁ paṭicca manasi karoti ekattaṁ
example_phrases.translation: attends to the oneness that depends on the signless unification of mind
example_phrases.notes: MN 121's last step before the outflows are seen to be absent.
